Description: A unique ID for this snapshot of the patient's health, linked to a patient.
The time this health state was recorded or inferred.
Time-series data of vital signs (heart rate, blood pressure, etc.).
A list of active diagnoses (e.g., ICD-10 codes).
The system's **belief** about the future evolution of this health state.
A score representing the system's belief about the patient's QoL.
